comment: Allow-list for cmd/json2pptx/text_fit_corpus_test.go (TestTextFitCorpus). Templates whose sha256 appears in 'exceptions' are exempt from the text-fit corpus gate. Failures on allow-listed templates are reported via t.Logf so they remain visible in CI output but do not fail the test. Each entry MUST cite a tracking issue and SHOULD be removed once the template is repaired (the sha256 will then no longer match, restoring the gate). Use `shasum -a 256 templates/<file>.pptx` to read the sha256. The list MUST be empty once go-slide-creator-vqad and its children land.

exceptions.reason: Designer template: body placeholder on the 'Title' layout and the body/body_2 placeholders on the 'Section break with image 01' layout overflow at content densities (P0–P2) that other templates handle. Repair under parent go-slide-creator-vqad.
Designer template: undersized body slots on 'UNKNOWN IF USED 01' and 'BLANK - Left LARGE Logo' overflow at densities (P1–P4) that should fit. Repair under parent go-slide-creator-vqad.
Designer template: body and body_2 placeholders on '42_Custom Layout' overflow at trivial densities (P0–P1) where peers fit comfortably. Repair under parent go-slide-creator-vqad.
